signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with the username and password you were given.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forced: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

page.title: Account
page.devicesCount: No other device is signed in | One other device is signed in | {count} other devices are signed in
page.signedOutOthers: Your other devices were signed out.

unavailable.suspended: {shop} can't be used right now. Contact the platform team to resume it.
unavailable.noShop: This account doesn't belong to a shop. Contact the platform team.

validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes
validation.moneyKhr: Type a whole number of riel, like 13500
validation.moneyUsd: Type dollars with up to 2 decimals, like 12.50

customers.title: Customers
customers.emptyDescription: Customers are added here or while taking an order.
customers.name: Name
customers.formerDescription: This customer was anonymized: their name, phone and note were removed. Their orders are kept.
customers.anonymizeDescription: Their name, phone and note are removed for good. Their orders are kept and show "Former customer". This can't be undone.

settings.title: Shop settings
settings.name: Shop name
settings.phoneHelp: Shown to customers on their ticket page.
settings.currencyHelp: Every price and total is in this currency.
settings.currencyLocked: Can't change once the price list has items.
settings.languageHelp: For Telegram messages and the ticket page.
settings.reminderHelp: Remind customers this many days after their order is ready ({min}–{max}).
settings.policyHelp: Shown on the ticket page. At most {max} characters.

pricing.title: Price list
pricing.emptyDescription: Start with a service type, like "Wash & iron", then add its prices.
pricing.noItems: No prices in this service type yet.
pricing.notFound: This isn't in the price list.
pricing.archiveServiceTypeDescription: It won't be offered for new orders. Archive its prices first.
pricing.archiveItemDescription: It won't be offered for new orders. Past orders keep their prices.
pricing.priceChangeHelp: A new price applies to new orders only.

shops.title: Shops
shops.emptyDescription: Create the first shop and its owner.

newShop.title: New shop
newShop.description: The shop and its owner's account are created together. Give the owner the username and temporary password; they choose their own password at the first sign-in.
newShop.name: Shop name
newShop.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like sokha-laundry. Can't be changed later.
newShop.priceSectionDescription: The shop starts with its own copy of a template's services, items and prices, in the template's currency. You can change the shop's prices later.
newShop.noTemplate: No template: an empty price list

shop.title: Shop
shop.resetPasswordDescription: Give the owner a new temporary password. They are signed out on every device and choose their own password at the next sign-in.
shop.passwordReset: The password was reset and the owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.revokeSessionsDescription: Use this when the owner's phone is lost. The password doesn't change.
shop.revokeSessionsConfirm: Sign the owner out on every device?
shop.sessionsRevoked: The owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.suspendDescription: The owner can still sign in but can't use the shop. Its ticket pages show "unavailable". Nothing is deleted.
shop.resumeDescription: The owner can use the shop again.
shop.priceListDescription: Its services and prices, in {currency}. The owner sees them; only the platform changes them.
shop.receiptDescription: The image a customer gets on Telegram: the shop's own slip, filled in with the order.

templates.title: Templates
templates.emptyDescription: A template is a ready-made price list: its services, its clothing items and their prices. Pick one when you create a shop.
templates.description: List the services and clothing items in the order the shop's paper slip has them, then give each item a price in each service it's offered in. A new shop gets its own copy: changing this template later doesn't change shops already made from it.
templates.archivedNotice: This template is archived: it isn't offered when creating a shop. Restore it to change it.
templates.name: Template name
templates.servicesHelp: Like wash & iron, dry clean, iron only. Staff choose one per line.
templates.itemsHelp: The rows of the slip, like shirt, pants, coat. Choose kg for items weighed.
templates.pricesHelp: In {currency}, per piece or per kg. Leave a cell empty where the item isn't offered.
templates.archiveDescription: It won't be offered when creating a shop. Shops already made from it keep their prices. You can restore it later.

lines.invalidPieces: Enter a whole number from 1 to 9999
lines.invalidKg: Enter the weight in kg, like 2.5

orders.title: Order #{number}
orders.notEditable: This order can no longer be edited: it's ready, collected or cancelled.
orders.paidLocked: This order is paid, so its lines stay as they are. You can still change the note.

confirm.paymentDescription: Record it once the customer has paid the full amount.
confirm.cancelDescription: The order stays in the list as cancelled. This can't be undone.
confirm.cancelPaidDescription: This order is paid: give any refund outside the app. The order stays in the list as cancelled. This can't be undone.
confirm.collectUnpaidDescription: The customer hasn't paid {total}. Hand the order over anyway?

orders.customerMore: And {count} more in the orders list.

slip.nothing: Fill in at least one item
slip.tooMany: At most {max} items on one order
slip.saved: Order saved. Write this number on the bag:
slip.noPricesDescription: The shop's price list is set up by the platform. Contact support to add your prices.
slip.name: Name

board.unpaidDescription: {total} isn't paid yet. Did the customer pay now?

receipt.title: Receipt for order {number}
receipt.description: What the customer gets on Telegram.
receipt.missing: Your shop's receipt isn't designed yet. Ask support to set it up.

more.title: More
more.supportDescription: New prices, new items, a problem: message us and we'll set it up for you.

receipts.title: Receipt
receipts.emptyDescription: Upload a photo or scan of the shop's paper slip (PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB, 200 to 2000 pixels a side). Then place the order's details on it.
receipts.tooBig: This image is over 1 MB. Make it smaller and try again.
receipts.canvasHelp: Drag a field to move it, or select it and use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps). Text sits on its dot.
receipts.addHelp: It appears in the middle; drag it into place.
receipts.noFields: No fields yet. Add the order's details from the list above.
receipts.previewDescription: Made by the server with made-up values, exactly as a customer gets it on Telegram.
receipts.conflict: This design was changed in another tab. Reload to see it; your unsaved changes here will be lost.
receipts.removedEntry: An item no longer in the price list
